target: Refute Day-Johnson Conjecture 1.1 (Stylianou arXiv:2510.25392v1): exhibit k>=5 with equilibria on Q_n for infinitely many n; candidate k=8 subspace profiles m=(t+1,t,...,t), n=7t+1.
exact_prop_to_prove: exists k>=5, forall N, exists n>=N, exists k-player profile P on Q_n with IsEquilibrium P (pure Nash, equal tie-splitting, co-location allowed, moves to any vertex allowed)
outcome: PARKED - no proof for an infinite family; exact gap identified (Missing Lemma M, PROOF.md Part D)
exact_results_proved: Lemma 1: every player of a subspace profile scores 1/8; equilibrium iff no target beats 1/8 for player 0
Lemma 2: exact shape-reduced finite binomial-sum formula for the deviator score
Lemma 3: uniform-shift identity and 4-dimensional lift (14 functionals (f,b))
Lemma 4: one-coordinate step identity sigma(e_j)-1/8 = (1/2)[Delta(g_perp)-Delta(g_1)] and exact vanishing Delta(g_1)=0
Parity lemma: D^0_a = psi(a) mod 2; psi(t+1,t,...,t)=f_1 != 0 for all t
Observation: Stylianou-balanced 4-player profiles are exactly 2-dim subspace profiles, so his Theorem 1.2 is the d=2 analogue valid for all multiplicities; d=3 fails for uniform multiplicities
negative_results_exact: one-step integrand not pointwise / translation-averaged / sign-class nonpositive
score not coordinatewise monotone in shape (637 / 5109 increasing unit steps at t=2,3) although no nonzero local maxima and level maxima strictly decrease

analytic.gaussian_corner_slope: Proposition C1 (rigorous in Gaussian model): dGamma/dc_g = -(3/4) h_o / t, h_o = int phi^3 Phi^5 = 0.0083306; i.e. 8 Gamma = 1 - 6 h_o |c|/t + ...
analytic.local_expansion_derived_not_proved: lim t(8 sigma(c)-1) = -h_o(6|c| + 2[|c| odd]) if psi != 0; = h_o(-6|c| + 14[|c| odd]) if psi = 0 (all shapes |c|<=4). Explains the empirical psi rule; matches exact data t<=8 (e.g. 0.06652 vs 0.06664 at t=8).
